trailhead.label: The car park beside the SS42 at the mouth of the Val Strino, the board’s start

cautions: You cross the busy SS42 at the start: keep your dog on a short lead.
The gravel military road is open to cars with a permit: keep your dog close if one comes.
Cows graze the Val Strino pastures in summer.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.The car park beside the SS42 at the mout: Il parcheggio accanto alla SS42 all’imbocco della Val Strino, la partenza ufficiale
textIt.You cross the busy SS42 at the start: ke: Alla partenza attraversi la trafficata SS42: tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.The gravel military road is open to cars: La strada militare sterrata è aperta alle auto con permesso: tieni il cane vicino se ne arriva una.
textIt.Cows graze the Val Strino pastures in su: In estate le mucche pascolano nella Val Strino.
